notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Will of the Temur
description:
Cast Will of the Temur by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Will of the Temur, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Will of the Temur, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
